headline: School officials pivoted toward a Neary addition-renovation plan as base repair scope narrowed, while the School Committee aligned teacher pay scales with Algonquin.
synopsis: School planners and the School Committee evaluated capital options for Neary Elementary School, finding that a $15 million base repair yields only $5.8 million in direct construction after mandated fire suppression and accessibility upgrades. Meanwhile, administrators reported that the ongoing Neary roof replacement is nearly 90 percent complete and expected to return roughly $2 million in surplus funding to the town. The School Committee also voted to align teacher salary schedules with Algonquin Regional High School starting in July 2027. In other municipal business, the Golf Committee finalized its warrant strategy for course irrigation funding ahead of Special Town Meeting, and the Board of Health granted a septic setback variance for a residential conversion.

highlights.title: Neary School renovation options and cost analysis
highlights.why: Architects demonstrated that a $15 million repair option provides only $5.8 million for direct construction after required code upgrades, steering the committee toward an estimated $38 million addition and renovation plan.

highlights.title: Neary roof surplus and school building updates
highlights.why: The district reported that the Neary roof project is nearly finished and projected to return nearly $2 million of its $4.5 million appropriation back to the town.

highlights.title: Teacher contract amended to align salaries with Algonquin
highlights.why: The School Committee voted 5-0 to amend the Unit A collective bargaining agreement, adjusting retirement incentives and matching Southborough teacher pay scales with Algonquin starting July 1, 2027.

highlights.title: Town Meeting preparation for golf course irrigation article
highlights.why: The Golf Committee agreed to advocate for its warrant article as written, seeking to extend $550,000 in existing CPA funds alongside roughly $350,000 in new CPA funding and $100,000 from revolving funds.

highlights.title: Drone light show contract executed for tricentennial kickoff
highlights.why: Organizers finalized an agreement for a 200-drone aerial light show on January 1, 2027, which will feature custom visual formations designed by local middle school students.

highlights.title: Septic variance approved for 66 Breakneck Hill Road
highlights.why: The Board of Health unanimously approved an 85-foot setback variance for an advanced nitrogen-reducing septic system to support converting a commercial property into a four-bedroom single-family home.

looking_ahead.what: Special Town Meeting, including golf course irrigation warrant article
